parse_list_of_floats: parse a string or list of floats and round each number to 4 decimal places
calculate_iq_score: calculate the Physics IQ score and physical variance from a CSV file containing model metrics
process_directory: process all CSV files in a directory to compute Physics IQ scores and generate a bar plot
test_parse_list_of_floats: test the parse_list_of_floats function with string and list inputs containing numeric values
test_calculate_iq_score: test the calculate_iq_score function with a CSV file containing perspective view metrics
